quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not independent findings or live runtime draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive judgments inspect actual labels and ordinary secondary senses; assess excesses too. No topic/homophone/transitive-closure rule.
知人: acquaintance is identical to 知り合い title and already deduplicates; ordinary friend/acquaintance families and ご存じ sense2 support declared comparisons without asserting close friendship.

地帯/地点: compare actual area/region/location labels directly; broad region and specific point are not automatically one clique. Existing specialized site words are included for review of possible excesses.

縮む/縮める: similar English shrink/reduce labels can overlap despite transitivity. Actual 縮小 includes both verb perspectives; 詰める and 省略 explicitly teach shortening. Public curling sense matters against 縮れる. くるくる actual hair example differs from literal rotation.

チップ: gratitude/gift comparison and physical tip secondary senses assessed separately; source1077740 tip and2850287 chip identities not conflated. Broad token/fragment topics do not automatically create every chip guard.

茶色い: exact 茶色 brown title already deduplicates; 茶 has ordinary brown sense with unlike title. 着々: declared orderly/steady/smooth-progress comparisons are bounded judgments; mere motion, reliability or gradualness alone is not a universal equivalence.

中間: physical/intermediate/neutral senses compared directly, including 中性. 中旬: actual 半ば mid-month and middle labels; exact calendar boundaries are still taught. 中途: partway during course need not equal spatial exact center; no transitive extension of 中間 guards.
中年: actual おじさん title includes middle-aged man, not every adult/age category. 彫刻: actual 刻む engraving overlaps; broad art/craft topics alone do not imply synonyms.
No declarations on 抽象,中世,中性. This is not exhaustive semantic uniqueness or native-speaker certification. Existing 超過 exclusions retained unchanged.
